knowledge.name: Owner Requirement: Electrical-First Automation
knowledge.summary: Automate centralized power first, then electric mining and transfers, then separated smelting arrays with automatic feed, output and service. No agent fuel runs.

applicability.when_to_use: Planning, selecting methods or judging full automation for this owner, especially after a short burner-powered demonstration.
applicability.when_to_skip: Do not apply as a claim about already available prototypes, unlocks or supported operations.
live_checks: Inspect current capabilities and live force/surface prototype, recipe, technology and energy facts before choosing machinery.
Prove centralized power and its automatic service, electric mining and electric transfer where available, separated smelting feed/output and automatic smelting fuel supply if required.
Inspect the currently admitted placement catalog for the required electric miner. If unsupported, report the tool gap before a future goal rather than substitute burner miners silently.

concepts: The owner defines full automation as a system that does not require the agent to fuel individual machines. A manually stocked burner line or a short run on prefilled fuel does not satisfy this requirement.

Default progression: establish centralized, automatically sustained electricity first; use electric miners and electric inserters where live availability and tool support permit; organize separated smelting arrays with automatic feed, output and service.

Initial manual priming is permitted only as a declared finite bootstrap phase. Central power fuel and any smelting fuel that live machines require must then be automatically supplied; do not turn continued fuel runs into the operating design.
Direct burner mining-to-furnace methods remain bootstrap candidates only under this goal. Catalog existence does not authorize a substitute architecture or establish an unlock.
interpretation_checks: Before calling the goal fully automated, verify the power, mining, transfer, smelting and output chain after the finite bootstrap, including service replenishment; prefilled stocks and short positive output alone are insufficient.
If required machinery or control is unavailable, report the exact live/tool gap. Do not claim that all machines are electric, unlocked or supported.

known_failure_modes: Treating a prefilled burner line or short production window as sustained full automation.
Silently substituting burner drills for an unsupported electric miner.
